name: Venomancer: Alkahest grants Viridian Renewal for instant Emerald Veil even on full-health targets (#13686)
contract: Viridian Renewal (706938, CharacterAdvancement 7121) tooltip: 'Healing done by Alkahest now causes your next Emerald Veil to be instant cast.' Its buff 707097 applies SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (-100% SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) on SpellFamilyName 35 mask (0, 0, 0x40000), which matches every Emerald Veil rank (800926..801152, base cast time 2500 ms).

AscensionVenomancerEvents.cpp gated 706938 on HealInfo::GetEffectiveHeal(), which is 0 whenever Alkahest heals a full-health target, so overhealing with Alkahest never granted 707097 and Emerald Veil stayed a 2500 ms cast.

Expected: casting Alkahest rank 8 (578310) on a full-health self grants Viridian Renewal (707097) once (not twice on a self-heal), drops Emerald Veil rank 6 (801152) cast time from 2500 ms to 0 ms, lets Emerald Veil complete immediately and consume 707097 so cast time returns to 2500 ms, and still procs on an injured target. A control Venomancer without 706938 gains neither 707097 nor any cast-time reduction.

SETUP: no Viridian Renewal buff before casting Alkahest
Venomancer casts Alkahest on full-health self
Control casts Alkahest on full-health self
SETUP: Venomancer Alkahest heal landed
SETUP: control Alkahest heal landed

DISCRIMINATING: self-cast Alkahest triggers Viridian Renewal once, not twice

CONTROL: without Viridian Renewal, Emerald Veil keeps its 2500 ms cast time
